title: Late Fees Carried into the Settlement of a Stopped Project
content:
# Late Fees Carried into the Settlement of a Stopped Project

How much of the late fee history of a project under Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects is carried into its settlement depends on how many late fees the project has run up.

## Rule

Where no late fee has been raised on the project, the settlement carries the billings raised and no late fee is charged into it.

Where exactly one late fee has been raised on the project, the settlement carries the billings raised together with half the late fees raised on the project, that is 50 per cent of them.

Where two or more late fees have been raised on the project, the settlement carries the billings raised together with every late fee raised on the project in full.

The count is of late fee lines standing on the project's billing record; the sum taken is the total of those lines.

## Judgement table

| Late fee lines on the project | Total of those lines | Carried into the settlement beside the billings raised |
|---|---|---|
| none | — | nothing |
| one | USD 480 | USD 240.00 |
| two | USD 960 | USD 960.00 |
| five | USD 2400 | USD 2400.00 |

A single slip is met half way; a project that has gone past its due day repeatedly carries the whole of what it has run up.
